$comment: 编辑用分块，由 build.py 拼进 request.schema.json。

setFormControlOp.description: 改一个已有窗体控件的标题、链接、列表、勾选或选中项。
setFormControlOp.descriptionEn: Change the caption, link, list, check state, or selected item of an existing form control.
setFormControlOp.limits: 只改已有的按钮、复选框、下拉。caption 同时写 Choice 的 a:t 和 VML 文本框，空字符串不合法。fmlaLink、fmlaRange 为 null 时两处一起去掉。checked 为 true 时写 checked=Checked 和 x:Checked 为 1，为 false 时两处一起去掉。有链接格时同时把该格写成布尔值。sel 同时写 formControlPr 和 x:Sel，不改 val。按钮不能设链接、列表、勾选、选中项。复选框不能设列表和选中项。下拉不能设链接和勾选。没有 a:t 或没有 VML 文本框时不能设 caption。一个字段都不给则报错。不改对象名和锚点。不插入、不删除。只能改 worksheet。
setFormControlOp.limitsEn: Only an existing button, check box, or drop-down can be changed. caption is written to both the Choice a:t and the VML text box; an empty string is invalid. A null fmlaLink or fmlaRange removes both copies. checked true writes checked=Checked and x:Checked 1; false removes both. When a link cell exists, that cell is also written as a boolean. sel is written to both formControlPr and x:Sel, and val is left unchanged. A button cannot take a link, list, check state, or selected item. A check box cannot take a list or selected item. A drop-down cannot take a link or check state. caption is rejected when a:t or the VML text box is missing. Giving no field is an error. The object name and anchor are not changed. There is no insert or delete. Only a worksheet can be changed.
